events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Sam Darnold hit Jamison Crowder for a 1-yard touchdown pass in the fourth quarter, and the New York Jets avoided finishing their fourth consecutive season with double-digit losses in a 13-6 win over the Buffalo Bills' backups Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets close season with 13-6 win over playoff-bound Bills

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw for a touchdown and ran for another Sunday in his farewell as a franchise quarterback -- a Joe Burrow banner in the upper deck reminded him what comes next -- and the Cincinnati Bengals ended one of their most miserable seasons with...
headlines.shortLinkText: Fond farewell: Andy Dalton leads Bengals over Browns 33-23

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Mason Crosby kicked a 33-yard field goal as time expired, lifting the Green Bay Packers to a 23-20 win over the Detroit Lions to earn a first-round bye.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers barely beat Lions 23-20 to earn first-round bye

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Mecole Hardman returned a kickoff 104 yards for a touchdown, Damien Williams took a handoff 84 yards for another score, and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the Los Angeles Chargers 31-21 on Sunday to leapfrog New England for the No. 2 seed in the AFC and...
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs top Bolts 31-21 to earn No. 2 seed, first-round bye

headlines.description: Eddy Pineiro's fourth field goal of the game for Chicago came from 22 yards with 10 seconds left, giving the Bears a 21-19 victory over Minnesota on Sunday with the Vikings resting their regulars for the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears edge Vikings 21-19 on Piñeiro FG with 10 seconds left

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Miami dropped defending Super Bowl champion New England into the wild-card playoff round when Ryan Fitzpatrick tossed a 5-yard touchdown pass to tight end Mike Gesicki with 24 seconds remaining for a stunning 27-24 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins stun Patriots 27-24, denying NE first-round bye

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Deion Jones intercepted Jameis Winston on the first play of overtime and returned the ball 28 yards for a touchdown to give the Atlanta Falcons a 28-22 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones' INT return in OT lifts Falcons over Bucs 28-22

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: The New Orleans Saints took care of business against the reeling Carolina Panthers and finished off a 13-3 regular season but still might not get a week of rest in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints take care of Panthers, still hope for playoff bye

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw four touchdown passes to help Dallas beat Washington 47-16 on Sunday, a win rendered meaningless when the Cowboys were eliminated from the playoffs by Philadelphia's victory over the New York Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys beat Redskins 47-16, miss playoffs with Eagles' win

headlines.description: Shelby Harris knocked down Derek Carr's 2-point pass to Hunter Renfrow with 7 seconds left and the Denver Broncos put at end to the Raiders' dim playoff hopes -- and to Oakland's run as an NFL city with a 16-15 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos beat Raiders 16-15 to keep rival from playoffs

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Tyler Higbee and Robert Woods caught touchdown passes from Jared Goff in the fourth quarter, and the Los Angeles Rams bade farewell to the Coliseum and secured their third straight winning season with a 31-24 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams say goodbye to Coliseum with 31-24 win over Cardinals

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: Carson Wentz and the Philadelphia Eagles are heading to the playoffs thanks to a group of players off the practice squad.
headlines.shortLinkText: Injury-ravaged Eagles beat Giants 34-17 to win NFC East

headlines.description: This much seems certain for the Jacksonville Jaguars: Minshew Mania will continue into 2020.
headlines.shortLinkText: Minshew, Jaguars close out season with 38-20 win over Colts

headlines.description: Slogging through the rain without several notable stars and with very little at stake, the Baltimore Ravens relied on a strong defensive performance to beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 28-10 Sunday and finish the regular season riding a 12-game winning...
headlines.shortLinkText: Despite lacking star power, Ravens beat Steelers 28-10

headlines.description: Derrick Henry and the Tennessee Titans ran their way into the playoffs, beating a Houston Texans team that rested several starters and setting up an intriguing first-round matchup with New England.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans clinch playoff spot with 35-14 win over Texans

headlines.description: The road to the Super Bowl in the NFC will go through San Francisco for the first time since 1997.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers win NFC West, No. 1 seed with 26-21 win over Seahawks
